notes:
- **Archie Mobile is enough on its own.** Setting up a new agent no longer asks for a chat app on
  top of it: once the code is on screen, press Continue with Archie Mobile.
- **Your agent can find things in folders you pick on your computer**, like Warranties or Taxes.
  Pick them on the Knowledge tab. It names the file and the page, and Send me under the answer sends
  you the file. A file named like passwords is never sent.
- **Before a job likely to cost more than about 10 cents**, like a Deep Research question, your
  agent says about what it will cost and waits for you to press Go or Not now.
- **A morning list for every agent.** At the end of your first evening, your agent offers a 7:00am
  list of today's calendar, reminders, to-dos and email replies waiting on your Send. It also names
  a bill coming due, a late invoice, two things at once on your calendar, a lead gone quiet and a
  Paperwork deadline, each once.
- **The morning list starts with what is ready for one press**: replies already drafted, each with
  Send, Fix and Skip. Say yes, and your agent writes up to five of them overnight.
- **The first morning list of each week ends with what your agent did the week before**, in counts
  and dollars.
- **When a Price Watch check finds your price**, it gets a card with the price, the store and when
  it was checked. If you switched buying on, the card has Buy, and the order still waits for your
  tap.
- **A call's card lists what a receptionist may ask for**, like the name on the account, each beside
  a box. The call gives only what you tick, and never a card or bank number, a Social Security
  number, a password or a date of birth.
- **Email Manager and Text Replies can point out** someone new still waiting after an hour, a reply
  you owe, and an email asking to change where a payment goes, once you say yes.
- **Before your agent reads an email, Archie checks whether you know the sender**: on your lists, in
  what you told your agent about your work, or as someone you wrote to lately.
- **A draft that quotes a price you never gave** leaves it in brackets, and Send waits for you.
- **One draft, one card.** However a draft changes, you see one card with Send on it and a short
  line saying what changed.
- **Type "undo that"** and your agent shows what it changed the last time you asked it for
  something, with an Undo button beside each change.
- **If your computer slept through a routine or the morning list**, Archie names what did not go
  out, with a button to get it now.
- **A reply to a voice note is written for your phone to read aloud**: a table comes as one sentence
  a row, and a link goes after the answer.
- **With a screen reader on**, Archie says when your agent starts working and reads the answer as
  soon as it is done.
- **From Archie Mobile, bring a spreadsheet into a list**, and see the first rows as they will look
  before you press Add.
- **When your free trial ends**, your agent tells you three days and one day before, and what needs
  no AI keeps running in Archie afterward.
- **A free setup call.** Until December 31, 2026, the Setup tab offers a call of about 30 minutes
  with Jett or Jack to set up your AI account with you.
- **A plan that ended can be bought again** from the plans on the Account page.
- **On Archie for Teams, GoHighLevel stage and field changes can be made and told after**, with
  Undo, once the owner turns it on.
- Fixed: the notice that your chat app stopped reaching your agent counted time the computer was
  asleep.
